spec.arm_source: spec.arms is list(universes) from the producing loop; 'unscreened' is the untouched e27 loader, the gap arms are panel_screen.screen_universe(mode=neutralise_gap, gap_limit=k), all on one panel calendar
spec.books: me = month-end decisions; mid = first session on/after the 15th; both on one calendar, one universe per arm

published_control.note: the published twin was burned on an earlier cutoff, so a non-zero drift is a re-derivation through new data, not a producing-code difference

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count
the arm is a universe repair, not a different strategy: every arm keeps the same calendars, rank cache and fee ladder
coverage: a cell is emitted for every (era, book, arm) triple, so an era the burn could not populate shows up as null, never as a missing key
a level that moves across arms is not a level the repair created; it is a level the untreated panel was carrying on a repaired print
